items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Small's Paradise. All of these clubs were running around New York at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah, right, uptown, Monroe's uptown, Small's Paradise. All of these clubs were running around New York at that time. And New York was jumping, and then, all of the guys that played at theatres and all that kind of thing all drank downtown, at the White Rose, was a tavern there.
